lines.zh: 我摆着身子走，脚掌啪嗒响。
lines.en: I waddle along, webbed feet slapping.

lines.zh: 泥地太软，我一步一陷。
lines.en: The mud's soft; every step sinks in.

lines.zh: 我摇摇晃晃地赶去水边。
lines.en: I teeter my way down to the water.

lines.zh: 一群小鸭跟在后面，队形很乱。
lines.en: A line of ducklings trails behind, badly formed.

lines.zh: 翅膀张开一半，帮我保持平衡。
lines.en: I half-open my wings to keep my balance.

lines.zh: 我踩过一摊浅水，溅了满身。
lines.en: I cross a shallow puddle and splash myself.

lines.zh: 前面的草丛里有一条缝，我挤过去。
lines.en: There's a gap in the reeds; I squeeze through.

lines.zh: 走两步就停下来理理胸毛。
lines.en: Two steps, then a pause to preen my breast.

lines.zh: 岸边石头滑，我绕了远路。
lines.en: The bank stones are slick, so I go around.

lines.zh: 我朝水里走，脚掌先试了试。
lines.en: I head for the water; my feet test it first.

lines.zh: 芦苇比我还高，我钻得很费劲。
lines.en: The reeds tower over me and I push through.

lines.zh: 小鸭掉队了，我回头叫了一声。
lines.en: A duckling falls behind; I call back.

lines.zh: 走过木栈道，脚下一片空响。
lines.en: On the wooden walkway, every step echoes.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖尾羽，继续往前挪。
lines.en: I wag my tail feathers and shuffle on.

lines.zh: 我沿着田埂走，屁股一摆一摆。
lines.en: I walk the field ridge, hips swaying.

lines.zh: 过沟时我扑棱了两下翅膀。
lines.en: Crossing the ditch I flap twice.

lines.zh: 我浮在水上，随波轻轻晃。
lines.en: I float on the water, rocking gently.

lines.zh: 把头埋进翅膀里，眯了一会。
lines.en: I tuck my head into my feathers and doze.

lines.zh: 嘴在水面划出一圈一圈的纹。
lines.en: My bill draws rings across the surface.

lines.zh: 羽毛上有油，水珠滚下去。
lines.en: Oil in my feathers makes the droplets roll off.

lines.zh: 岸上那只猫蹲着，我不看它。
lines.en: A cat crouches on the bank; I ignore it.

lines.zh: 我划了两下脚，转了个方向。
lines.en: Two kicks of my feet and I've turned around.

lines.zh: 水面上的浮萍味道还行。
lines.en: The duckweed on the water tastes all right.

lines.zh: 太阳暖，我把脖子伸长了些。
lines.en: The sun's warm; I stretch my neck out.

lines.zh: 有一只鸭子叫，我应了一声。
lines.en: Another duck calls, and I answer.

lines.zh: 我把嘴伸进水里，搅了搅。
lines.en: I dip my bill and stir the water.

lines.zh: 这片沼泽的芦苇是我熟悉的。
lines.en: I know these reeds of the marsh well.

lines.zh: 雨落下来，我照样浮着。
lines.en: Rain falls and I keep floating anyway.

lines.zh: 我歪头看了看天，云走得很慢。
lines.en: I tilt my head up; the clouds move slowly.

lines.zh: 四点生命，但我会游会躲。
lines.en: Only four points of life, but I swim and hide.

lines.zh: 我把嘴埋进背羽，睡着了。
lines.en: I tuck my bill into my back feathers and doze.

lines.zh: 水里映出我的绿头，挺好看。
lines.en: My green head shows in the water; not bad.

lines.zh: 你站在岸边，我浮在中间。
lines.en: You're on the bank; I'm out in the middle.

lines.zh: 我歪头看你，另一只眼也在看。
lines.en: I tilt my head, and my other eye watches too.

lines.zh: 你手里那把面包，我认得。
lines.en: I know the bread in your hand.

lines.zh: 别急着靠近，水很浅。
lines.en: Don't rush in; the water's shallow here.

lines.zh: 我嘎了一声，短促地。
lines.en: I let out one short quack.

lines.zh: 你动，我就往芦苇那边靠。
lines.en: If you move, I drift toward the reeds.

lines.zh: 你的靴子沾了泥，和我一样。
lines.en: Your boots are muddy, same as my feet.

lines.zh: 我看你的时候，脖子先伸出去。
lines.en: When I watch you, my neck goes out first.

lines.zh: 你蹲下来，水面照见你的脸。
lines.en: You crouch; the water shows your face.

lines.zh: 小鸭都躲到我身后了。
lines.en: The ducklings have all hidden behind me.

lines.zh: 你要不要也下水试试。
lines.en: Aren't you going to get in the water too?

lines.zh: 我眨了下眼，眼皮是白的。
lines.en: I blink, and my eyelid flashes pale.

lines.zh: 我缩起脖子，伏得很低。
lines.en: I pull my neck in and crouch low.

lines.zh: 羽毛掉了几根，飘在水上。
lines.en: A few feathers drift down onto the water.

lines.zh: 翅膀垂着，飞不起来了。
lines.en: My wing hangs; I can't take off.

lines.zh: 这一下打在我的胸口。
lines.en: That landed square on my breast.

lines.zh: 我嘎地叫了一声，声音都破了。
lines.en: My quack comes out cracked.

lines.zh: 我一路瘸着往芦苇里跑。
lines.en: I limp toward the reeds as fast as I can.

lines.zh: 脚掌被踩了一下，站不稳。
lines.en: My foot got stepped on; I can't stand firm.

lines.zh: 水面被我的血染了一点。
lines.en: A little of my blood stains the water.

lines.zh: 小鸭在叫我，我得撑住。
lines.en: The ducklings are calling; I have to hold on.

lines.zh: 再来一下我就撑不住了。
lines.en: One more hit and I won't last.

lines.zh: 面包屑撒下来，我立刻游过去。
lines.en: Breadcrumbs hit the water; I paddle straight over.

lines.zh: 你手里还有，别一次给完。
lines.en: You've more in your hand; don't give it all at once.

lines.zh: 我够得到，不用你丢。
lines.en: I can reach it; no need to throw.

lines.zh: 我把嘴伸过去，轻轻一叼。
lines.en: I stretch my bill out and take it gently.

lines.zh: 这只小鸭抢得比我快。
lines.en: The duckling grabs it faster than I do.

lines.zh: 种子比面包硬，可我爱吃。
lines.en: Seeds are harder than bread, but I love them.

lines.zh: 你的手放低点，我够不着。
lines.en: Lower your hand; I can't quite reach.

lines.zh: 我在你脚边转圈，等下一块。
lines.en: I circle your feet, waiting for the next piece.

lines.zh: 水面上的油花别喂我。
lines.en: Don't feed me anything slick with oil.

lines.zh: 吃完了我还想再要一点。
lines.en: Done eating, and I'd still like a bit more.

lines.zh: 你甩一下手，我追着水花跑。
lines.en: Flick your hand and I chase the splash.

lines.zh: 这味道我从没在沼泽里闻过。
lines.en: I've never smelled this in the marsh before.

lines.zh: 我叼着跑了，别追。
lines.en: I'll take it and run; don't follow.

lines.zh: 你蹲久一点，我就敢贴近。
lines.en: Stay crouched a while and I'll come close.

lines.zh: 你手里那把麦粒在动。
lines.en: That handful of wheat in your hand moves.

lines.zh: 我伸脖子，先试探你的手掌。
lines.en: I stretch my neck and test your palm.

lines.zh: 你踩到我脚边，我让开了。
lines.en: You step by my feet; I get out of the way.

lines.zh: 翅膀被撞开，我稳住身子。
lines.en: My wing's knocked open; I steady myself.

lines.zh: 我们挤在窄岸边，一起歪了。
lines.en: We crowd the narrow bank and both stumble.

lines.zh: 你膝盖碰到我，我嘎了一声。
lines.en: Your knee bumps me and I quack.

lines.zh: 我往水里退，水花溅到你鞋上。
lines.en: I back into the water, splashing your shoes.

lines.zh: 小鸭被撞散，我赶紧拢回来。
lines.en: The ducklings scatter; I herd them back.

lines.zh: 别用脚拨我，我会咬。
lines.en: Don't nudge me with your foot; I bite.

lines.zh: 木头栈道太窄，我们侧身过。
lines.en: The walkway's narrow; we edge past sideways.

lines.zh: 我被挤得滑进泥里。
lines.en: I get squeezed and slide into the mud.

lines.zh: 这一撞，我的羽毛乱了。
lines.en: That bump has left my feathers ruffled.

lines.zh: 我绕着她游，脖子一伸一缩。
lines.en: I swim around her, neck pumping in and out.

lines.zh: 她用嘴理我后颈的毛。
lines.en: She preens the feathers on my nape.

lines.zh: 我们并排浮着，谁也没说话。
lines.en: We float side by side, neither of us quacking.

lines.zh: 我把找到的种子让给她。
lines.en: I give her the seeds I found.

lines.zh: 她的叫声比我低一点。
lines.en: Her call sits a little lower than mine.

lines.zh: 水面上，我们的波纹叠在一起。
lines.en: On the water, our ripples fold into each other.

lines.zh: 我守着芦苇丛，她进去下蛋。
lines.en: I guard the reeds while she goes in to nest.

lines.zh: 我们一同把头扎进水里。
lines.en: Together we dip our heads under.

lines.zh: 她挪一步，我的脚掌也跟着响。
lines.en: She shifts a step, and my feet echo hers.

lines.zh: 小鸭孵出来后，我们分头带。
lines.en: Once they hatch, we'll each take half the brood.

lines.zh: 我叼起一根水草，甩了甩。
lines.en: I pick up a strand of weed and shake it.

lines.zh: 这粒种子掉在泥里，我捡了。
lines.en: A seed fell in the mud; I take it.

lines.zh: 亮东西我不吃，但会看看。
lines.en: I don't eat shiny things, but I do look.

lines.zh: 你掉的扣子滚到水边，我啄了一下。
lines.en: Your button rolls to the water; I peck it.

lines.zh: 太沉了，我叼不动。
lines.en: Too heavy; my bill can't lift it.

lines.zh: 我把浮萍拨到小鸭那边。
lines.en: I push the duckweed toward the ducklings.

lines.zh: 这枚铁片凉，我吐了出来。
lines.en: The iron scrap is cold; I spit it out.

lines.zh: 水里漂着的纸，我绕开。
lines.en: Paper floating in the water; I steer around it.

lines.zh: 我用嘴把树枝挪到一边。
lines.en: I move the twig aside with my bill.

lines.zh: 捡起来也没用，可我就是想捡。
lines.en: It's useless, but I still want to pick it up.

lines.zh: 芦苇里有东西动，我先看住。
lines.en: Something stirs in the reeds; I keep watch.

lines.zh: 那只猫的尾巴在摇，不好。
lines.en: That cat's tail is twitching — not good.

lines.zh: 水下的影子比我的身体大。
lines.en: The shadow underwater is bigger than me.

lines.zh: 我盯住那只靠近的乌龟。
lines.en: I fix on that turtle coming closer.

lines.zh: 你的脚步太急，我记下了。
lines.en: Your steps are too quick; I've noted it.

lines.zh: 空中有只猛禽在盘旋。
lines.en: A hawk is circling overhead.

lines.zh: 小鸭都朝我这边靠了。
lines.en: The ducklings have all pressed toward me.

lines.zh: 那边水面有泡泡冒上来。
lines.en: Bubbles are rising over there.

lines.zh: 我认出你了，刚才是你扔的石头。
lines.en: I know you — you threw the stone earlier.

lines.zh: 我盯得越久，越觉得不对。
lines.en: The longer I watch, the less I like it.

lines.zh: 我往水中间游，离岸远些。
lines.en: I paddle toward open water, away from the bank.

lines.zh: 我一直侧着头，用一只眼看。
lines.en: I keep my head turned, watching with one eye.

lines.zh: 它再靠近，我就潜下去。
lines.en: One more step from it and I dive.

lines.zh: 我把小鸭拢在翅膀下面。
lines.en: I gather the ducklings under my wings.

lines.zh: 我嘎嘎叫了两声，是警告。
lines.en: Two sharp quacks from me — a warning.

lines.zh: 岸太近，我慢慢往外划。
lines.en: The shore's too close; I paddle farther out.

lines.zh: 我盯着它，脚在水下没停。
lines.en: Eyes on it, my feet keep working underwater.

lines.zh: 只要它一动，我就飞起来。
lines.en: The instant it moves, I'll take off.

lines.zh: 这水里我比它快。
lines.en: In the water I'm faster than it.

lines.zh: 我退到芦苇边，那里能藏。
lines.en: I retreat to the reeds, where I can hide.

lines.zh: 我用嘴啄了一下你的手背。
lines.en: I peck the back of your hand.

lines.zh: 翅膀拍起来，力气不小。
lines.en: My wings beat hard enough to sting.

lines.zh: 我咬住你的袖口，往后扯。
lines.en: I clamp your cuff and pull backward.

lines.zh: 这一下只够让我脱身。
lines.en: That's just enough to get me free.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，又赶紧退回水里。
lines.en: I lunge, then hurry back into the water.

lines.zh: 别抓我，我的嘴很有劲。
lines.en: Don't grab me; my bill has force.

lines.zh: 我护着小鸭，所以会咬。
lines.en: I'm guarding ducklings, so I'll bite.

lines.zh: 脚掌蹬了一下，水花全溅起来。
lines.en: My foot pushes off and water sprays everywhere.

lines.zh: 我打不过你，但我不躲。
lines.en: I can't beat you, but I won't hide.

lines.zh: 啄完我就叫，叫得很响。
lines.en: After pecking, I quack as loud as I can.

lines.zh: 我从芦苇丛里钻出来，身上还湿。
lines.en: I push out of the reeds, still wet.

lines.zh: 脚一落地，就走得歪歪扭扭。
lines.en: I land and immediately waddle crookedly.

lines.zh: 四点生命，轻得能被风吹动。
lines.en: Four points of life, light enough for wind to move.

lines.zh: 我第一眼看见的是一片水。
lines.en: The first thing I see is a stretch of water.

lines.zh: 我抖了抖绒毛，水珠四散。
lines.en: I shake my down and droplets fly.

lines.zh: 沼泽的蛙声把我叫醒了。
lines.en: The frogs of the marsh woke me.

lines.zh: 我试着叫了一声，声音很细。
lines.en: I try a quack; it comes out thin.

lines.zh: 芦苇的影子落在我背上。
lines.en: A reed's shadow lies across my back.

lines.zh: 我朝最近的水边挪过去。
lines.en: I shuffle toward the nearest water.

lines.zh: 从今天起，这片浅滩归我。
lines.en: From today, this shallows belongs to me.

lines.zh: 火一烤，我的羽毛就卷起来。
lines.en: The heat curls my feathers at the edges.

lines.zh: 我从岸上摔下去，翅膀没张开。
lines.en: I fall off the bank without opening my wings.

lines.zh: 水从嘴边灌进去，我蹬着往下沉。
lines.en: Water pours past my bill; I kick and sink.

lines.zh: 气浪把我掀进水里，耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: The blast throws me into the water, ears ringing.

lines.zh: 箭擦过羽毛，削掉一小片。
lines.en: An arrow shaves a patch of feathers off my back.

lines.zh: 光罩住我，翅膀像被绑住。
lines.en: Light wraps me and my wings feel tied.

lines.zh: 水草吃完了，肚子饿得发慌。
lines.en: The weeds are gone and my belly aches.

lines.zh: 雷打在水面，亮得我睁不开眼。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and the glare blinds me.

lines.zh: 脚下没有水，只有一直往下。
lines.en: No water below, just endless falling.
